blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday said they see no need to change their strategy in presenting witnesses at Duterte’s impeachment trial, maintaining that they do not coach or interfere with their testimonies. Lawyer Michael Poa, counsel and spokesperson for Duterte’s defense team, said the lawyers do not prepare witnesses before presenting them in court to avoid accusations of tampering with their testimonies. “Right now, I don’t think there’s a need to change anything. As I said, we don’t want to be accused of coaching witnesses or tampering with any of their testimonies or […]...
